definition.def: When you terminate something or when it terminates, it ends completely. [formal]
examples: Her next remark abruptly terminated the conversation. [VERB noun]
His contract terminates at the end of the season. [VERB]

definition.def: To terminate a pregnancy means to end it. [medicine]
examples: After a lot of agonizing, she decided to terminate the pregnancy. [VERB noun]

definition.def: When a train or bus terminates somewhere, it ends its journey there. [formal]
examples: This train will terminate at Taunton. [VERB preposition/adverb]

definition.def: If an employer terminates an employee, they dismiss them from their job. [mainly US]
examples: He has never terminated an employee. [VERB noun]
As a result of the investigation, twelve officers were terminated. [be VERB-ed]

definition.def: the act of ending something; the end of something
examples: Failure to comply with these conditions will result in termination of the contract.

definition.def: a medical operation to end a pregnancy at an early stage
examples: She chose to have an early termination.
